question.instructions: How should any external link or off-platform invite in the post be handled?

criteria.RmLink: Strip or disable the link but keep the post.
criteria.Brigade: Treat the link as coordinated brigading and action it as abuse.
criteria.Escalate: Send the link to a specialist to assess before acting.
